title: Silent Night
writers: Franz Xaver Gruber (music, 1818) and Joseph Mohr (German lyrics, 1816); English lyrics by John Freeman Young

evidence.note: The German original was composed in 1818 (lyrics 1816), but the English version almost always sung today is a later translation: Episcopal priest John Freeman Young wrote and published it in 1859.

famous_use: Bing Crosby recorded 'Silent Night' with Paul Whiteman's orchestra, one of the earliest well-known commercial recordings of the song.
